content:
This week coincides with the July Black Friday sales event, with many eye-catching deals on Apple products flooding in. Among them, the AirPods discount is the most attractive, making it the best time to buy in several months:

On top of the above offers, Amazon has launched the 2026 AirTag 2 for as low as $22 each, the official iPhone Air MagSafe Battery with a massive 40% discount, the Apple Magic Keyboard hitting an all-time low, continued deals on the Apple Watch Series 11 starting from $299, and discounts of up to $400 on various MacBook Pro configurations with M5/Pro chips.
